Context: 8. Horizontality ofReservation.-

- Reservation for backward classes of citizens (SCs, STs and OBCs) is called vertical reservation and the reservation for persons with benchmark disabilities and ex-servicemen is called horizontal reservation. Horizontal reservation cuts across vertical reservation (in what is called interlocking reservation) and persons selected against the quota for persons with benchmark disabilities have to be placed in the appropriate category viz. SC/ST/OBC/Unreserved depending upon the category to which they belong
